import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static List<Integer>[] e = new List[2020];
    static int[][] ir = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] sc = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] pc = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] s = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] p = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dd = new int[20][20];
    static final int[] dx = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static List<Integer>[][] ns = new List[20][20];
    static List<Integer>[][] np = new List[20][20];

    static void add_edge(int a, int b) {
        e[a].add(b);
        e[b].add(a);
    }

    static int[] dist_to_sink = new int[2020];
    static int[] partner = new int[2020];
    static int source_count, sink_count;

    static boolean bfs() {
        Deque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= source_count; ++i) {
            if (partner[i] == 0) {
                dist_to_sink[i] = 0;
                q.addLast(i);
            } else {
                dist_to_sink[i] = 3010;
            }
        }
        dist_to_sink[0] = 3010;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.pollFirst();
            if (dist_to_sink[u] < dist_to_sink[0]) {
                for (int i = 0; i < e[u].size(); ++i) {
                    int v = partner[e[u].get(i)];
                    if (dist_to_sink[v] > dist_to_sink[u] + 1) {
                        dist_to_sink[v] = dist_to_sink[u] + 1;
                        q.addLast(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist_to_sink[0] != 3010;
    }

    static boolean dfs(int x) {
        if (x == 0) return true;
        for (int i = 0; i < e[x].size(); ++i) {
            int u = partner[e[x].get(i)];
            if (dist_to_sink[u] == dist_to_sink[x] + 1) {
                if (dfs(u)) {
                    partner[x] = e[x].get(i);
                    partner[e[x].get(i)] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int hopcroft_karp() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= source_count; ++i) {
                if (partner[i] == 0) {
                    ans += dfs(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int n, t;

    static void work(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                dd[i][j] = 100000;
            }
        }
        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dd[a][b] = 0;
        q.addLast(new int[]{a, b});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.pollFirst();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < np[x][y].size(); ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < ns[a][b].size(); ++j) {
                    add_edge(ns[a][b].get(j), np[x][y].get(i));
                }
            }
            if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                    dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                ir[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            s[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            p[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        source_count = 1;
        sink_count = 1000;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char ch = s[i][j];
                if (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    sc[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; ++k) {
                    if (ns[i][j] == null) ns[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                    ns[i][j].add(source_count++);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char ch = p[i][j];
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    pc[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; ++k) {
                    if (np[i][j] == null) np[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                    np[i][j].add(sink_count++);
                }
            }
        }

        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.addLast(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.pollFirst();
            rx = cell[0];
            ry = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = rx + dx[d];
                int ny = ry + dy[d];
                if (ir[nx][ny] > ir[rx][ry] + 1 && sc[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[rx][ry] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sc[i][j] > 0) {
                    work(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(hopcroft_karp());
    }
}
